title: Images and Multimedia
description: Learn how to add and manage images, audio, and video elements in HTML to enhance your web pages.

lessons.title: Inserting Images with
Understanding alt Text
lessons.content: The `alt` attribute in the tag provides alternative text when the image cannot load. It also improves accessibility for users relying on screen readers.

lessons.title: Image Attributes: width, height, title
Adding Background Images with CSS
lessons.content:
<style>
  body {
    background-image: url('background.jpg');
    background-size: cover;
  }
</style>

<!-- Use CSS for decorative or layout-related images -->

lessons.title: Inserting Audio with <audio>
lessons.content:
<audio controls>
  <source src="music.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
  Your browser does not support the audio element.
</audio>

<!-- <audio> lets users play audio files in-browser -->

lessons.title: Inserting Video with <video>
lessons.content:
<video width="320" height="240" controls>
  <source src="movie.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  Your browser does not support the video tag.
</video>

<!-- <video> displays videos with playback options -->

lessons.title: Autoplay, Loop, and Muted Attributes
lessons.content:
<video autoplay loop muted>
  <source src="loop.mp4" type="video/mp4">
</video>

<!-- Control playback behavior using autoplay, loop, and muted -->

lessons.title: Best Practices for Media Files
lessons.content: Always compress media files for web use, use appropriate formats like WebP for images and MP4 for video, and provide fallbacks or captions for accessibility.

lessons.title: Responsive Images with srcset
Embedding YouTube Videos
lessons.content:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

<!-- Use <iframe> to embed external videos like YouTube -->
